_help: Edit this file before the first run.
root      : project root, relative to this folder (or absolute). '..' assumes
pdf_review/ sits inside the paper repository.
pdfs[]    : one entry per PDF; 'path' is relative to root and may be a glob.
sources   : free text, copied into every revision request -- where the .tex lives.
notes     : free text, extra hints for the assistant (figures, sync rules, ...).
bib       : .bib file used by Cite mode (optional).
on_verified: instruction emitted for citations marked Verified (optional).
Entries whose file does not exist are silently ignored, so unused templates are harmless.
